name: SendMessage

parameters.help_en: The custom task name. It cannot contain special characters and can be up to 40 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义任务名称，不能包含特殊字符，最长40个字符
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SMS template. You can view the ID in the console
parameters.help_zh: 短信模版编号，可以在控制台查看
parameters.name: message_template_id

parameters.help_en: The replacement parameters for the dynamic parameter in SMS messages. The format is {1}{2}
parameters.help_zh: 动态参数短信，替换的参数，格式{1}{2}
parameters.name: message_variable_param

parameters.help_en: The timestamp. Unit: seconds. If the specified time is earlier than the current time, the message is sent immediately. If the specified time is later than the current time, the message is sent at the scheduled time. The scheduled time cannot exceed one month from the current time
parameters.help_zh:
时间戳，单位：秒 。

当时间早于当前时间则立即发送，晚于当前时间为定时发送。

最晚不能超过一个月
parameters.name: message_send_time

parameters.help_en: The list of destination MSISDNs to which the SMS messages are sent
parameters.name: msisdns

false：添加失败
